high_output.proof: For a high output, every right shift on its value-operand chain must have count0. A T-only ancestor has equal LSB on this pair, while both target outputs are high and have different LSBs.

rectangle.proof: Every integer polynomial in the ten coordinates has mixed difference zero modulo 2^32; all coordinate increments are divisible by 2^16.

rectangle.MAD_amount_proof: A first MAD has common low16 and mixed difference0 on the rectangle. At most1 amount can be>=32, otherwise zero shift results collide. At least3 amounts thus equal the same r<32; mixed difference0 forces the fourth to equal r as well. A last MAD is at most quadratic in the sole shifted low word; a last bitop is unary bitwise. All297 possibilities fail.
rectangle.initial_amount_proof: Every initial word is>=32 on all4 states. An initial-word shift amount makes that shift result0. The other shift is then literal or has count0; the same297 unary/quadratic tests apply.

high_middle.proof: A final SHR producing a high output has count0, so its middle MAD/bitwise data word must already equal the target on these samples. The MAD relaxation is quadratic in five base words and q; a bitop preserves same-position indistinguishability.

dependent_second.proof: Second count=first_q. When first_q>=32 the second result is0; when first_q=0 it is an initial word or root constant. A last MAD is quadratic in base words plus first_q (or base words alone). A last bitop cannot distinguish the recorded identical top-bit signatures.

T_S_order_partition.TTT: No downward bit transfer: target LSB flips on b16 while all initial LSBs stay fixed.
T_S_order_partition.STT: Initial-word amount makes shift0 on the rectangle; prepared-root amounts use the fixed-shift core audit.
T_S_order_partition.TST: Initial/root amounts as above; a BIT-computed amount uses the computed-amount audit; a MAD-computed amount uses the rectangle. Constant data sources and t>>t are separately closed.
T_S_order_partition.TTS: High-output ancestor pair: final right shift must have count0, and its T-only data ancestor has equal LSB on the pair.
T_S_order_partition.TSS: High-output ancestor pair along every value-operand shift chain.
T_S_order_partition.STS: For initial/root constant value ancestors use the high pair. For middle T value ancestors, high-output quadratic/bitwise tests cover every first fixed shift; initial-word first amounts make q=0 on all selected high samples.
T_S_order_partition.SST: Both prepared-root amounts use fixed-shift core. An initial-word amount uses the rectangle. Second amount=first_q uses297 conditional quadratic/bitwise tests. A constant first source reduces to prepared-root amounts.
T_S_order_partition.SSS: High-output ancestor pair along the value-operand shift chain.

S_operation: uint32 right shift with initial/earlier/root-constant value and amount
scope: At most3 straight-line MAD/XOR/AND/OR/SHR operations over nine stated live words, arbitrary root-prepared constants and arbitrary data-dependent SHR operands. No DIV/REM/CDIV/comparison/data-dependent SHL/FLOW/load/store or larger windows; no global kernel optimality claim.
